description: Authored synthetic history of one policyholder at a fictional insurer, for reproducible acceptance: 2 policies and 9 claims. A development script replays the authored history once through the App. The fixture keeps the 22 newest notifications and every activity row. It is not a benchmark task. The evaluation dataset in data/evaluation/ is a second synthetic source: 36 account seeds with claim history from late 2024 to 2026-12-31. It is not loaded by default.

sources.description: Authored synthetic records; no external collection. The insurer, people, shops, lender and policies are fictional. Two public pages were read only for the shape of the workflows, and no text, data, form or brand was copied: the auto claims process of Progressive (https://www.progressive.com/claims/auto-process/) and the Fair Claims Settlement Practices Regulations of California, for response time limits (https://www.insurance.ca.gov/01-consumers/130-laws-regs-hearings/05-CCR/fair-claims-regs.cfm).

Synthetic evaluation dataset in data/evaluation/: one seed and one binding per fictional policyholder account, and manifest.json. Every record is synthetic and none was observed or collected. A seeded script writes scripted claim stories and replays them through the App hooks, so the App accepted every step. Its coverage report is data/evaluation/coverage.json.

transformations: Normalized timestamps and account IDs. Records are policies and claims; a claim holds its evidence, requests, estimates, decisions, disputes, offers, rental periods and payments.
Evaluation seeds: each claim story is replayed through the App hooks up to the seed clock. Steps at or after the clock are not in the seed.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
